_note: The game's sound system (Phase 8 Step 1; docs/AUDIO.md; audio/system.js, audio/mix.js, audio/dsp.js). groups: each mixer group's level before the player's own volume for it (the settings' sliders, 0–100%). master: the compressor that holds loud moments together, then the look-ahead limiter (ceiling dBFS) so nothing ever clips. voices: other cars' sounds — the nearest `full` get the whole sound (engine, tyres, the lot), the next `simple` within simpleM a cheap one (one loop and a filter), none further; a car keeps its voice `hold` s before it changes (fading over `fade` s); on low quality only lowFull full voices. budget: the audio's CPU — audio thread work as a share of the time it plays (desktop, every sound on, an 8-car race), the main thread's ms a frame for the audio, and a low-end device taken as lowEndFactor × slower (its own share, on low quality). views: what each camera hears: exhaust, intake and gearbox levels, the tyres, road and wind, the exhaust's low-pass (muffle, Hz), the outside world's low-pass (outside: other cars and the environment, Hz) and the cabin's boom (dB at 110 Hz); roofOpen: the same with the roof down. distance: other cars (refM, rolloff: inverse distance; maxM: silent beyond); air: the low-pass at distance (Hz at refM, halving every halfM). doppler: speed of sound (m/s), most a pitch can move (share). occlusion: a car behind buildings or a hill: gain and low-pass (Hz), checked every `every` s. reverb: each place's echo — seconds long, how loud (send), how bright (hz) — and the slap between walls; probe: the rays round the listener (up and sideways, m). tyres: where scrub starts and the squeal and skid (combined slip: 1 is the tyre's grip limit) and the slip speed they need (m/s). surfaces: what each surface sounds like (audio/dsp.js SURFACES), by name (the worlds' surface tables), else by its sound. bumps: a thump through the suspension past compressionSpeed m/s (full at full), at most every `gap` s a wheel. brakes: the share of stops whose brakes squeal (below speed m/s, at light pressure). lowQuality: what the low setting turns off.
